firstBuild.reason: Local variable slots collided with Qt macro; renamed to leafSlots. Final native Linux/Windows builds pass.

firstNativeRun.reason: Runner executable was still from SDK1.20 while rebuilding. Final runner separately passes 437 cases.

firstIndexComparison.reason: New duration assertion failed to subtract final Opus discard_padding reported separately by FFprobe; comparison corrected; all final tests pass.

linuxFullRunSignal.reason: Linux full launcher received SIGTERM after 32 PASS media variants, no player assertion failure. All 50 variants and API/source regressions subsequently pass in 8 shorter CTest groups, concurrency 3.

earlyRegressionRestart.reason: Initial full Linux run and waiting Windows launcher stopped before media matrix to rebuild final Vorbis 200ms seek-preroll/capabilities. Final full tests run against the recorded EXE hashes.

limitations: VP8 8-bit initial displayed keyframe, no scaling/CodecPrivate; full payload decoding remains in backend
Vorbis I mono/stereo 48kHz, floor1, bounded codebooks/setup; other rates/floors/Ogg/fMP4 Vorbis unsupported
Configuration validation is structural, not complete residue/codebook integrity proof; mutation acceptance does not certify decodability
Known VOD duration, two separate resources, contiguous confirmed prefix, known-size clusters, DefaultDuration video; no lacing/encryption
Qt verifies active audio codec/rate and changing decoded frames; Classic verifies graph/status/decoder reads without physical output measurement
No physical A/V sync, 30-minute drift, HDR/final 10-bit surface or 4K realtime qualification
Muxed/remux, unknown-size clusters, segments/live, extra tracks/metadata and real Harvester integration remain outstanding
Installed Windows EXE/profiles unchanged; hardware and Wayland excluded; YouTubeHarvester unchanged
